description: Unit test class for DefaultAuthenticationResult, testing its methods and behaviors related to authentication success or failure results.

classes.name: DefaultAuthenticationResultTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing DefaultAuthenticationResult's behavior regarding success, failure, and associated data retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes common test data including authorization context, ditto headers, and failure reason.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that DefaultAuthenticationResult has proper equals and hashCode implementations.

methods.name: getSuccessfulInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures method throws NullPointerException if null ditto headers are provided for success.

methods.name: getSuccessfulInstanceWithNullAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Ensures method throws NullPointerException if null authorization context is provided for success.

methods.name: getFailedInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Ensures method throws NullPointerException if null ditto headers are provided for failure.

methods.name: getFailedInstanceWithNullReasonOfFailure
methods.description: Ensures method throws NullPointerException if null reasonOfFailure is provided for failure.

methods.name: successfulInstanceIsSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that a successful authentication result reports success.

methods.name: failedInstanceIsNotSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that a failed authentication result reports failure.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersFromSuccessfulInstance
methods.description: Checks that the ditto headers from a successful instance include authorization context.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersFromFailedInstance
methods.description: Checks the ditto headers from a failed instance.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextFromSuccessfulInstance
methods.description: Confirms retrieval of authorization context from a successful authentication result.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextFromFailedInstanceOfRuntimeException
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving authorization context from a failed result returns the exception.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContextFromFailedInstanceOfError
methods.description: Ensures that retrieving authorization context from a failed result throws an IllegalStateException with cause.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailureFromFailedInstance
methods.description: Checks retrieval of reasonOfFailure from a failed result.

methods.name: getReasonOfFailureFromSuccessfulInstance
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to get reasonOfFailure from a success throws an exception.
